typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		MemberID as string,
		AuthID as string,
		AuthStatus as string,
		ProviderID as string,
		UrgentIndicator as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(FileIID = $File_IID,
		MEMBERNUMBER = MemberID + '00',
		CREATE_DATE = currentTimestamp(),
		Market_CD = toString($MarketID)) ~> AddFileIdandMemberNumber
AddFileIdandMemberNumber sort(asc(MemberID, false),asc(AuthID, false),asc(AuthStatus, false),asc(ProviderID, false),asc(UrgentIndicator, false),asc(MEMBERNUMBER, false),asc(FileIID, false),asc(CREATE_DATE, false),asc(Market_CD, false)) ~> RemoveDuplicates
RemoveDuplicates window(over(MemberID,
		AuthID,
		AuthStatus,
		ProviderID,
		UrgentIndicator,
		MEMBERNUMBER,
		FileIID,
		CREATE_DATE,
		Market_CD),
	asc(MemberID, true),
	asc(AuthID, true),
	asc(AuthStatus, true),
	asc(ProviderID, true),
	asc(UrgentIndicator, true),
	asc(MEMBERNUMBER, true),
	asc(FileIID, true),
	asc(CREATE_DATE, true),
	asc(Market_CD, true),
	Rank_col = rowNumber()) ~> RemoveDuplicatesdistinct
RemoveDuplicatesdistinct filter(Rank_col == 1) ~> RemoveDuplicatesdistinctFilterComponent
RemoveDuplicatesdistinctFilterComponent sink(input(
		UMPreCert_AuthID as string,
		UMPreCert_CREATE_DATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		URGENT as string,
		UMPreCert_AUTH_STATUS as string,
		UMPreCert_PROVIDERID as string,
		UMPreCert_MEMBERNUMBER as string,
		FILEIMPORT_IID as integer,
		UMPreCert_MARKET_CD as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		UMPreCert_AuthID = AuthID,
		UMPreCert_CREATE_DATE = CREATE_DATE,
		URGENT = UrgentIndicator,
		UMPreCert_AUTH_STATUS = AuthStatus,
		UMPreCert_PROVIDERID = ProviderID,
		UMPreCert_MEMBERNUMBER = MEMBERNUMBER,
		FILEIMPORT_IID = FileIID,
		UMPreCert_MARKET_CD = Market_CD)) ~> PDSUMPreCertInbound
